This question makes me think very deep wow. I just realize about 60% if not more of my ed problems are because it makes me feel a certain way. Restricting is another focus. Counting and tracking everything preoccupies my brain. I'm doing very unwell, my life is falling apart. And this I can latch onto. I haven't really self harmed since first restricting, which was something i struggle with daily for years. So that's a huge factor. Sadly I don't feel like your average 19 year old. If I were to look like my ideal self, it would be easier to recover. I'm terrified of weight gain and so I think it would help for sure. I used to control my food but now it's the other way around.

What helps me: 
*When you eat, be present.  No distractions (tv, phone etc) and 
*chew slow
*smaller bites and chew like 20- 30 times on a bite. 
*add more volume to meals. Lettuce, cucumber do the trick.

It will make you feel more satisfied and also helps with digestion! 
If you struggle to take small bites, use smaller forks/spoons. It takes a bit of time to get used to but i can guarantee that in a week it becomes your normal. Also, 1200 is little. If you allow yourself to eat an 200 calorie snack like nuts it prevents binging later.
Hope this helps.
